note: Every endpoint Fabric Warden calls on a server or hypervisor, with the published source it was verified against. All calls are reads.

proxmox.name: Proxmox VE API
proxmox.auth: Authorization: PVEAPIToken=USER@REALM!TOKENID=SECRET (API token; no CSRF token needed). Least privilege: the built-in PVEAuditor role on /, or VM.Audit + Sys.Audit + Datastore.Audit; VM.GuestAgent.Audit for guest IP addresses.

endpoints.used_for: Cluster name, node names and node IP addresses
Nodes, VMs, LXC containers and storage with CPU, memory, disk and status (type in vm, storage, node, sdn)
endpoints.permission: user: all; results filtered by the token's privileges

endpoints.used_for: onboot (start at boot) and NIC MAC addresses
Guest IP addresses (needs the QEMU guest agent in the VM)

proxmox.not_used: Ticket/cookie authentication; any POST, PUT or DELETE (power actions, config changes).

unraid.name: Unraid API (GraphQL)
unraid.auth: x-api-key: <API key>. Built into Unraid 7.2 and later; earlier releases need the Unraid Connect plugin. Create a key with read-only access.

endpoints.used_for: info.os, info.cpu, info.versions.core, metrics.cpu.percentTotal, metrics.memory, networkInterfaces, array (state, capacity, parities, disks, caches), docker.containers, vms.domains, upsDevices

unraid.not_used: Every mutation (array, Docker, VM and parity actions). The client refuses any document that is not a query before sending it.

docker.name: Docker Engine API
docker.auth: None by default. Expose the engine through a read-only socket proxy that allows only GET on the endpoints below; an optional bearer token is sent when a reverse proxy requires one.

endpoints.used_for: Host name, OS, kernel, CPU count, memory, container counts
Containers with image, state, status, ports and network addresses
Restart policy (always / unless-stopped count as autostart)

docker.not_used: Container stats (CPU and memory per container), exec, logs and every POST/DELETE.

node_exporter.name: Prometheus node_exporter
node_exporter.auth: None by default; optional bearer token for a reverse proxy.

endpoints.used_for: node_uname_info, node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, node_load1, node_boot_time_seconds, node_time_seconds, node_cpu_seconds_total (utilisation from two scrapes), node_filesystem_size_bytes / node_filesystem_avail_bytes, node_network_info (MAC addresses), node_exporter_build_info

node_exporter.not_used: SSH or any agent that can run commands.
